description: Ozette Wetlands variant A goal room. One measured doorway: the south (high-Z) gate, which is also the room's only connection in any layout it terminates (#641 corrected the phantom north portal — the original authors an in-room warp object at (0, -4.5), not a second doorway). The section exit stands on that warp pad, not on a wall door.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-0.02, 22.90) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side

anchors.description: in-room warp pad (original's o0s_warpm object; the section exit)

traversalNotes: DEAD-END topology: enter and leave via spawn_south; the section exit is the in-room goal pad, not a doorway.
DISPATCH RULE: any in-cell objective routes through corridor_mid (yt0xtl). Walk south_gate → corridor_mid → objective → corridor_mid → goal_pad.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
